notes.title: Chesstle Development Update
notes.notes:
Just 3 months until Chesstle releases on February 12!  We wanted to share a little bit about some new features that have been added since the Steam Festival demo version.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38885841/4595b5f3b27349dcc7d351ca8cf6307d43ba17c2.png[/img]

[b]Character Upgrades[/b]
Every piece you control can be upgraded for better damage and range of movement in exchange for upgrade points you have earned.  1 upgrade point is earned for each completed turn.

[b]Character Special Abilities
[/b]Every character gets 1 single use special ability per match.  These specials can quickly turn the tide of a battle.  For instance, the archer has the ability to attack over an ally soldier and the mage can switch places with any allied piece.  Use with caution!

We are also working on
[list]
[*] UI
[*] Player Statistics
[*] Steam Integration
[*] And, of course, bug fixes ;)
[/list]

Please join us on our [url=https://discord.gg/BNYrp6XGpt]Discord Server[/url]!

notes.title: Chesstle Demo Available During Steam Festival
notes.notes:
Chesstle is releasing an open demo during the Steam Game Festival Autumn Edition! 

During the festival, you can have a sneak peak of the multiplayer demo version.  

Invite a friend to play or join our [url=https://discord.gg/M7WNwE]Discord Server[/url] and play a developer today!

We hope you will enjoy Cheesstle :)

The Chesstle Team
